ai.summary: A Chinese university with ties to the People’s Liberation Army bought two Nvidia H200 AI chips despite being on a U.S. export blacklist, according to procurement records. Reuters also found evidence that institutions accessed restricted Nvidia-powered computing through domestic providers, raising questions about enforcement of export controls.
ai.title: Chinese university bought Nvidia H200 chips despite US blacklist

ai.summary: England’s higher-education regulator warned that AI can let students complete some assessments quickly and without reliable detection, putting the credibility of qualifications at risk. It is urging universities to use more supervised, closed-book and practical assessment formats.
ai.title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

ai.summary: OpenAI began beta-testing Businesses in ChatGPT, letting companies manage profiles and review aggregated engagement insights. It is also rolling out Business Agents for eligible U.S. businesses to answer customer questions and help users explore products and services.
ai.title: OpenAI Details Businesses in ChatGPT Offering in Beta

ai.summary: AI data and model-training startup Mercor raised $750 million in a Series D round valuing it at $20 billion, with investors including Nvidia and Benchmark. The company says it will use the funding to train and test AI agents on professional tasks.
ai.title: AI training startup Mercor valued at $20 billion in latest funding round

ai.summary: England’s Office for Students called AI-enabled coursework a serious challenge to fair grading and urged universities to increase the use of AI-resistant assessment. The regulator warned that institutions could face sanctions if they fail to develop reliable assessment formats.
ai.title: UK regulator threatens universities with sanctions unless they adopt AI-proof exam formats

quantum.summary: IBM announced its planned Nighthawk r3 processor, designed to execute circuits with up to 10,000 quantum operations across 520 programmable qubits. The company says it plans to link two r3 processors in 2027 to create a system with more than 1,000 qubits.
quantum.title: IBM Quantum Nighthawk Demonstrates New Levels of Speed and Quality, with Plans to Scale Beyond 1,000 Qubits in 2027

quantum.summary: IBM outlined new developer tools and hardware access, including pulse-level controls and capabilities for mid-circuit measurement and fast qubit reset. Its expanded error-correction tools include support for long-running repetition-code experiments on IBM hardware.
quantum.title: QDC 2026: what quantum developers need to know

quantum.summary: IBM, Oak Ridge National Laboratory’s Quantum Science Center, and AMD launched a co-design platform pairing an IBM quantum processor with ORNL’s Umbra supercomputer. The collaboration aims to help researchers develop quantum error-correction methods using quantum and classical computing together.
quantum.title: The year of advantage—and what comes next

quantum.summary: QuEra, Harvard, and Anthropic reported that AI-assisted circuit design produced circuits using fewer gates and qubits than existing designs in seven of eight tested algorithm building blocks. The result concerns circuit efficiency, not a demonstration of practical quantum advantage.
quantum.title: QuEra, Harvard and Anthropic: Claude designed quantum circuits that need fewer gates and fewer qubits
